{{Quote|And now for the awarding of special medals of valor and merit. Will the following cadets please step forward&mdash;Rand Nalleck''[...]''|General Mohc awards Rand Nalleck|<ref name="SftE" />}}
'''Rand Nalleck''' was a [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|of Carida]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. Nalleck joined the academy<ref name="SftE" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]],<ref name="Reader Date 1">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', and by extension the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio adaption]], at a date of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The text mentions that the cadets graduating have spent four years at the academy, thus placing Rand Nalleck's join date at [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]].</ref> and graduated<ref name="SftE" /> in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Reader Date 2">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', and by extension the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio adaption]], at a date of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> During the graduation ceremony, which was overseen by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]], Nalleck's name was called out by the general to receive a special award.<ref name="SftE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rand Nalleck was first mentioned in the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio adaption]] of the novella ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', which was released in [[1997]]. As the character's name is only given in spoken dialogue from the audio adaption, the actual spelling of the character's name cannot be determined.
